title: Kawan extension API contract definitions
$comment: Planning specification only. Select named $defs through reference; baseline API contracts remain separate. Dynamic event/tool/provider config payloads and domain invariants require resolved runtime contracts.

HeaderBinding.$comment: Outbound policy rejects forbidden headers and prevents raw auth secrets in literal config; actor cannot grant arbitrary secret refs.

ServerConnectionCreate.$comment: Default auth is api-key. Auth-none requires registered adapter capability/policy and explicit selection; never inferred from missing key.

ConnectionUpdate.$comment: If-Match required. Domain validates mode transition/auth-none capabilities/destination change; Direct-to-server cannot keep a missing key.

TreeMutation.$comment: Schema validates shape only; ChatService validates roles/edges/cycles/ownership/current-leaf and native metadata compatibility.

RunEvent.$comment: Kawan event v1 type-specific payloads; state/grants/tool dynamic result content validated by domain registry. This is not baseline wire payload or native SDK UIMessage stream.

ToolCall.$comment: Arguments additionally validated against selected/discovered tool schema and actor/resource grants. No server secret reference accepted from model.

UsageQuery.$comment: Actual HTTP query strings parsed and range/timezone/actor checked; date end exclusive. Missing/client/estimated tokens reported separately.
